BE SEPARATED FROM ITS OWN FAILURE TO OBSERVE: any probe whose "unhealthy" verdict is an ABSENCE (zero pixels, null adapter, empty texture) ! carry a POSITIVE CONTROL proving its READ PATH WORKS, ∨ it ? ⊥ distinguish *broken* from *unreadable*** — & the more damage is done the more CONFIDENT it looks, ∵ an all-zero read is EXACTLY what the real fault would produce|V895,V896,T739,T1086,T1093

V898|⚑⚑**A PIN THAT ENCODES A KNOWN DEFECT ! CARRY A TRIPWIRE THAT FAILS WHEN THE DEFECT IS FIXED — OTHERWISE THE WORKAROUND OUTLIVES THE BUG SILENTLY & BECOMES THE SPEC.** §T1096 pins `randomSeed: 0` on its Dawn twin ∵ §T1100's live path forces 0; a bare pin would go on passing FOREVER after the fix, quietly asserting the BROKEN behaviour. ∴ the gate ALSO asserts **Dawn @ the PROJECT's real seed must ⊥ MATCH** — so the day the wiring is fixed the gate REDS w/ *"remove the randomSeed: 0 pin and this tripwire"*. ⚑the general form: **every accommodation of a bug is a CLAIM THAT THE BUG EXISTS, & a claim that ⊥ be falsified is ⊥ a claim** — a workaround w/o a tripwire is how a defect graduates into an invariant nobody chose|V38,V147,T1096,T1100

V899|⚑⚑**A PERFORMANCE VERDICT MEASURED ON *ONE* GPU ARCHITECTURE IS ⊥ A PROPERTY OF THE MODEL — & THIS PROJECT'S ENTIRE PERFORMANCE PICTURE COMES OFF ONE MACHINE (Apple M3 Max, Metal, Chrome 151).** owner: *"never know if it may be different on Windows or different GPU architecture so options are good"* — & he is correcting a framing *I* wrote. §T1085 said `MATTE_FAST` **IS** slower on WebGPU (400 ms vs 311 ms wasm); the TRUE statement is *"is slower ON METAL, measured 2026-09-03"*. **A QUANTIZED BUILD LOSING ON APPLE'S GPU IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF RESULT THAT ? INVERT ON NVIDIA ∨ AMD, where int8 paths are ⊥ the same silicon.** ∴ **EVERY number ∈ §T1040/§T1044/§T1076/§T1083/§T1084/§T1088/§T1091/§T1096 IS SINGLE-ARCHITECTURE & ! SAY SO WHERE IT IS RECORDED** — the catalogue's own `DEPTH_PROVIDERS` already does this right (*"Measured 2026-09-01 on the owner's machine (Chrome 151, macOS, Apple metal-3)"*) & the newer rows DRIFTED from that discipline. ⚑**& the DESIGN consequence is the owner's real point: KEEP VIABLE OPTIONS.** a ladder ∨ a default chosen from one machine's numbers **BAKES THAT MACHINE INTO THE PRODUCT** ∴ a model that loses HERE ! ⊥ be cut on that evidence, & the per-model Backend chooser (§T1090) is ⊥ a legacy knob — **IT IS THE ESCAPE HATCH FOR EVERY ARCHITECTURE WE HAVE ⊥ MEASURED.** the general form: **§V895's over-general "measured" claim, ∈ the PERFORMANCE domain — & the tell is a sentence saying a model *IS* fast ∨ slow rather than *WAS*, on WHAT, WHEN**|V205,V895,T1040,T1085,T1090,T1095

V900|⚑⚑**FOUR RESOLVED HUES REQUIRE THE OPERATOR TO BE *BLOCK-DIAGONAL*, & A BLOCK-DIAGONAL OPERATOR HAS *NO BOUNDARY*. THAT IS §V891's TRADE PROVEN *MONOTONE & WITHOUT OVERLAP* ON THE ONE KNOB THAT CONTROLS IT.** `contrast` IS the community-bond-to-background-tie ratio ∴ it IS block-diagonality; swept (f900→1500): contrast 18 → frontier **0**, churn **0/350**, margins +0.158/+0.394/+0.153/+0.387 … 8 → frontier 0, churn 0, margins going negative … 3 → frontier 22, churn **0** … **1 → frontier 165, churn 57/350, & ALL FOUR MARGINS NEGATIVE (−0.196 to −0.199).** ⚑**FRONTIER & PALETTE MOVE MONOTONICALLY ∈ *OPPOSITE* DIRECTIONS & NEVER OVERLAP — MEMBERSHIP FIRST MOVES @ THE EXACT SETTING WHERE COLOUR IS ALREADY GONE.** ∴ **⊥ the reach, ⊥ the community count, ⊥ the density, & ⊥ WHICH GRAPH THE OPERATOR COMPUTES OVER** — moving a Laplacian onto a sparse adjacency changes *WHICH* graph is frontier-free, IT DOES ⊥ CREATE A FRONTIER. the general form: **a partition that is legible AS COLOUR is a partition whose blocks DO ⊥ TALK, & reorganisation is blocks talking** ∴ before asking an operator to both SHOW structure & CHANGE it, ask whether the SHOWING is the ABSENCE of the changing|V854,V865,V885,V891,T1074,T1079,T1081,T1082

V901|⚑⚑**NOTHING UNDER `src/devices/**` MAY IMPORT `src/mcp/**`. THE DEPENDENCY RUNS ONE WAY: MCP → DEVICES, APP → DEVICES, & NEITHER CONSUMER THROUGH THE OTHER.** §T1103 established this by construction & the worker flagged the hole itself: **it currently holds by a PARAGRAPH ∈ CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md & by nothing else, & THIS REPO'S OWN HISTORY SAYS THAT DECAYS** — the inversion §T1103 fixed was itself never forbidden, only never intended. ∴ a `no-restricted-imports` zone ∈ `eslint.config.js` (~6 lines), `**/*.test.ts` EXEMPT ∵ `device-bridge.test.ts` deliberately drives the device bridge through the REAL helper composition (`serve.ts`, `bridge-host.ts`). ⚑the general form & why the exemption is ⊥ a weakening: **a layering rule that forbids the TEST from composing the real product forces the test to compose a FAKE one** — the boundary is about what PRODUCTION code may reach, & an integration test proving the two halves still meet is the boundary's evidence, ⊥ its violation|V3,V11,V29,V63,T1103

V902|⚑⚑**ESLINT FLAT CONFIG *REPLACES* A RULE'S VALUE ON OVERLAP ∴ ADDING A NEW ZONE OVER FILES AN EXISTING ZONE ALREADY MATCHES *SILENTLY SWITCHES THE OLDER RULE OFF FOR THOSE FILES* — A GUARD THAT REMOVES A GUARD, W/ NO ERROR & NO DIFF TO NOTICE.** MEASURED (§V901's landing): the new `no-restricted-imports` zone on `src/devices/**` matched files the base §V3 `vgpu` config ALSO matched ∴ **landing §V901 W/O REPEATING `vgpuRestrictedPaths`/`vgpuRestrictedSyntax` WOULD HAVE DISABLED §V3 FOR THE WHOLE NEW FOLDER** — the one folder that talks to hardware. caught ONLY ∵ the worker PROBED it: a `vgpu` import under `src/devices/` still fails w/ the §V3 message (2 errors) ONLY BECAUSE the rule was repeated ∈ the zone. ∴ **EVERY NEW FLAT-CONFIG ZONE ! BE RED-VERIFIED AGAINST *THE RULES IT OVERLAPS*, ⊥ ONLY AGAINST ITS OWN** — the test is *"does the OLD guard still fire here"*, & a green suite says nothing ∵ **the removed guard only speaks when someone violates it.** ⚑& the second half, MEASURED ON THE SAME PASS: **`no-restricted-imports` w/ `patterns` visits `ImportDeclaration` & NOTHING ELSE** ∴ `import("../mcp/x.ts")` PASSED CLEAN while `from "../mcp/x.ts"` was caught — & **THE DYNAMIC SPELLING IS THE ONE ALREADY WRITTEN ∈ `device-bridge.test.ts:450` ∴ PRECISELY THE ONE A FUTURE NON-TEST FILE WOULD COPY.** the worker had WRITTEN A COMMENT ASSERTING ESLint 9+ HANDLES `ImportExpression`; **it was WRONG & only the probe found it — §V895's shape, ∈ a config comment, about the very rule being added** (& the identical hole is ALREADY documented for §V3). closed w/ `ImportExpression` + `require` selectors; 5/5 red, test file 0/5|V3,V11,V29,V63,V895,V901,T1103

V903|⚑⚑**A `valueStep` WHOSE DRAW RANGE GREATLY EXCEEDS ITS DOWNSTREAM CLAMP IS A *MOSTLY-CONSTANT SIGNAL WEARING AN ENVELOPE* — & E54 SHIPPED THE SAME MISTAKE ∈ *BOTH* ITS LANES.** MEASURED (§T1119) from the repo's own `cycleHash`/`smooth`: **DISTURB — `dstep1(min −3, max 1.2) → dlim1(clamp 0…0.5)` ∴ 71.4% OF DRAWS CLAMP TO ZERO, 15 draws ∈ the first minute & ONLY *3* FIRE, LONGEST SILENT RUN 7 DRAWS = 29 SECONDS OF NOTHING**, mean gap 14.5 s. **COUPLING — `cstep1 → ×2.6 → −0.45 → clim1(clamp 0.25…0.95)` ∴ a draw ≥0.538 PINS TO THE CEILING & ≤0.269 PINS TO THE FLOOR, ONLY 19% LAND ∈ THE INTERIOR — & measured, `clag1:bar` SITS AT EXACTLY 0.950000 FROM f1000 TO f3000 *CONTINUOUSLY*.** ∴ **the docblock's *"most phrases settled, an occasional one relaxes open"* IS, AT THIS SEED, TWO THOUSAND FRAMES OF FLAT MAXIMUM COUPLING.** ⚑the general form: **a clamp is ⊥ a limiter on a signal that RARELY REACHES IT — when the draw range is several times the clamp width THE CLAMP *IS* THE SIGNAL, & the envelope you authored exists only ∈ the parameters, ⊥ ∈ the output.** ∴ **state the DUTY CYCLE, ⊥ the range: what fraction of draws land ∈ the interior, & what is the LONGEST SILENT RUN** — a mean gap hides a 29-second hole, & an owner watching for 30 s sees a dead file & is RIGHT|V436,V885,T1070,T1113,T1119

V904|⚑**NO RENDER-PHASE STATE UPDATE ANYWHERE ∈ `App` IS SAFE WHILE `useGraphCompile`'s MEMO MUTATES `lastCompile.current` *DURING RENDER*.** MEASURED (§T1123): React's SANCTIONED "adjust state during render" makes React **DISCARD THE PASS & RE-RUN THE COMPONENT** — & on the re-run that ref already held the NEW document ∴ the second document was **CLASSIFIED AGAINST ITSELF**, `documentBoundary` came back FALSE, & **A LOAD STOPPED CLEARING TEMPORAL HISTORY: §B106 REINTRODUCED FROM *FOUR FILES AWAY*.** caught by `document-boundary.test.tsx` + `load-history-reset.test.ts`. ⚑the general form: **a ref written during render turns React's OWN legal escape hatch into a CORRECTNESS BUG ∈ AN UNRELATED FEATURE — & the blast radius is every component ∈ the same render pass, ⊥ the file that did it.** ∴ either the memo stops writing during render, ∨ render-phase updates ∈ `App` are forbidden by rule; **the current state is that both are allowed & they are incompatible**|V29,B106,T1123

V905|⚑⚑**§V885's `motion` ROW MEASURES FRAMES 60–180 — A 2-SECOND WINDOW LYING *ENTIRELY INSIDE `cstep1`'s FIRST DRAW* ∴ IT STRUCTURALLY *? ⊥ SEE* A DUTY CYCLE, & IT REPORTED A LIVELIER FILE AS A REGRESSION.** MEASURED (§T1127): the row FELL 0.03393 → 0.02956 (−12.9%) while **the same instrument's own arithmetic run over THE WHOLE MINUTE (29 windows of 120 frames) reads 0.03181 → 0.03706, *+16.5%*.** the recorded window sits inside the ONE PHRASE that got more condensed, & the shipped `clag1:bar` was FLAT FROM f989 ∴ the row is IDENTICAL either way. ⚑the general form: **a look baseline sampled ∈ ONE SHORT WINDOW measures THE OPENING TRANSIENT, ⊥ THE FILE** — & for any file whose liveliness IS its envelope, that window is the one thing guaranteed ⊥ to contain the answer. ∴ **a baseline row ! state WHAT WINDOW IT SAMPLES & WHY THAT WINDOW ? SEE THE PROPERTY IT CLAIMS**, & a row that falls while the measured quantity rises is A BROKEN INSTRUMENT, ⊥ a regression to tune away. ⚠ compounding: **the row had ALSO been stale by +4.8% since §T1114 never re-stamped it** ∴ part of the "fall" was the stale value catching up|V885,V903,T1114,T1127

V906|⚑⚑**A GATE WRITTEN AGAINST `DEFAULT_X` GOES *SILENTLY VACUOUS* THE DAY `DEFAULT_X` MOVES — PIN IT TO THE ARRANGEMENT IT WAS ACTUALLY ABOUT, ⊥ TO WHATEVER THE DEFAULT HAPPENS TO BE.** MEASURED (§T1125): the §T927/§T932-era layout gates followed `DEFAULT_PANE_TREE` around, & moving the libraries to a left dock made **`restoreBaselineRegion(DEFAULT_PANE_TREE, "left")` A NO-OP ∴ THOSE GATES WOULD HAVE GONE GREEN-BY-EMPTINESS**, still named for a behaviour nothing was checking. fixed by re-intending them against a `SHIPPED_T932_TREE` FIXTURE — **the arrangement they were about, & THE ONE USERS STILL HAVE STORED** — & by destroying the dock the §T931 way (drag its last tabs out) first, which is **the only situation a user ? now be ∈.** ⚑the general form: **a test that reads a MOVING CONSTANT tests the constant, ⊥ the behaviour — & when the constant moves the test does ⊥ FAIL, it stops MEANING anything**, which is strictly worse ∵ its name still claims coverage. ∴ **a gate about "what users have" ! hold that arrangement as a FIXTURE**; only a gate about "what a fresh profile gets" may read the default|V713,B150,T927,T931,T932,T936,T1125

V907|⚑⚑**A FLAKE IS USUALLY *WAIT ON ONE HALF, ASSERT THE OTHER* — ⊥ A BUDGET TOO SMALL. DIAGNOSE THE RACE; A FLAKE W/ A LONGER TIMEOUT IS STILL A FLAKE.** MEASURED (§T1129): `src/mcp/bridge.test.ts` failed under load & **NO BUDGET WAS EVER INVOLVED — every failing run finished the whole file ∈ ~5.2 s against a 5 s poll budget.** 2 races, one shape: **(a) 4 §T925 tests waited on `bridgeStatus().attached`, which flips when THE *SERVER* PUTS THE FRAME ON THE WIRE, then asserted THE PAGE'S MEMORY — & `bridge-client.ts` does `memory.write(...)` THEN `publish("connected")`, BOTH A ROUND TRIP LATER ∴ the assertion read a gap NOTHING CLOSED.** now waits on the client's own `connected` = **THE EVENT THAT HAPPENS-*AFTER* THE WRITE, & A DIFFERENT OBSERVABLE FROM THE ONE ASSERTED.** **(b) the §T921 roster test waited on `pairingCode` (set by `proxyAttached`) while THE ROSTER IS A *SECOND* ROUND TRIP — & the common interleaving is quieter still: the proxy is seated BEFORE the page attaches ∴ the roster ∈ hand is the incumbent's HEADLESS one until `toolsChanged` moves it.** both moves now awaited ∈ order, each on the `notifications/tools/list_changed` **the product itself emits when the roster changes hands.** ∴ **the rule: WAIT ON AN OBSERVABLE THAT IS *CAUSALLY DOWNSTREAM* OF WHAT YOU ARE ABOUT TO ASSERT, & PREFER AN EVENT THE PRODUCT ALREADY EMITS FOR THAT TRANSITION.** proof by repetition, ⊥ by one green run: **24 concurrent runs old → 3 failed; new → 24/24 GREEN, TWICE**|V713,B150,T921,T925,T1111,T1129
V908|⚑**ENUMERATE THE *EXCLUSIONS*, DERIVE THE *INCLUSIONS* — ∵ A FORGOTTEN EXCLUSION IS A LOUD RED A REVIEWER RESOLVES & A FORGOTTEN *INCLUSION* IS A GATE THAT SILENTLY SEES NOTHING.** §T1103's move made §T1005's pump scan blind to `src/devices/` (§T1129) precisely ∵ the scan enumerated 6 ROOTS TO LOOK ∈. §T1129 checked the cost before choosing: **walking ALL of `src` minus the 2 DOCUMENTED exclusions yields EXACTLY the 2 registered pumps — no false positives, no extra ledger** (6 directories → 688 files, hit set UNCHANGED). ∴ the asymmetry is ⊥ a style preference, it is **which failure mode you get when the tree moves under you**|V906,T1005,T1103,T1129

V909|⚑⚑**A LIST BUILT FROM THE BUS *DURING RENDER* IS BUILT BEFORE THE SURFACES PUT THEIR COMMANDS BACK — & OPENING A DOCUMENT *REPLACES THE RUNTIME*.** MEASURED (§T1124): `app.tsx` does `setRuntime(createAppRuntime(…))` on open ∴ **THE NEW BUS STARTS W/ ONLY THE COMPOSITION ROOT'S ~50 COMMANDS & EVERY SURFACE-OWNED COMMAND IS PUT BACK BY THAT SURFACE'S OWN EFFECT.** the command palette built its list ∈ THE RENDER THAT FIRST SAW THE NEW BUS — before those effects — & **ITS MEMO NEVER RECOMPUTED ∴ THE STALE LIST STOOD FOR AS LONG AS THE PALETTE STAYED OPEN: 50 COMMANDS INSTEAD OF 85**, w/ `ui.openLayouts`, `layout.reset`, `ui.showProblems`, `ui.openHelp`, `ui.openSettings` & `ui.showNodeInfo` SIMPLY ABSENT. ⚑**IT HEALS ON CLOSE-&-REOPEN, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY IT WAS NEVER FILED** — & §T1123's first-boot STARTER *IS* A DOCUMENT OPEN ∴ **the window now exists ON EVERY FRESH BOOT.** ∴ **ANYTHING ENUMERATING A REGISTRY THAT SURFACES POPULATE ! BUILD ∈ AN EFFECT & RE-BUILD WHEN THE REGISTRY IDENTITY CHANGES** — & the gate ! be RACE-FREE by construction (open the palette, SWAP THE RUNTIME UNDER IT, assert the door survives), ⊥ by ordering luck|V307,V904,T954,T1123,T1124

V910|⚑⚑**AN ASSERTION PLACED *BEFORE* THE CODE UNDER TEST SHORT-CIRCUITS THE TEST — THE RED RUN THEN "PASSES", FOR THE WRONG REASON, & THE LOAD-BEARING CLAIM IS NEVER EXERCISED.** MEASURED (§T1068): the gate asserted the emitted FIELD first, so the `it` returned before THE LOADER EVER RAN & `expect(loaded.changed).toBe(false)` — the ACTUAL claim, that a freshly authored file needs NO migration — was dead code. moved last & verified separately: neutralised, the red run now REACHES it & gets `true`, **the migration actually happening.** ⚑the family this belongs to, & it is the 5th instance ∈ 2 days (§T1095's `per second` regex, §T1006's empty-registry query, §T1123's 60 ms wait inside a 2 s debounce, §T1064's ordering): **A GATE ? BE VACUOUS ∈ MORE WAYS THAN IT ? BE WRONG, & EVERY ONE OF THEM LOOKS GREEN.** ∴ **red-verify ⊥ merely that the gate FAILS, but that it fails *@ THE ASSERTION YOU CARE ABOUT* — & put the claim that names the behaviour LAST, where nothing ? return before it.** & the §T1068 worker's own probes did the same thing to IT: **its first 2 walked 0 nodes (they assumed a `document` wrapper the JSON does ⊥ have) & it caught them ONLY by CROSS-CHECKING AGAINST A RAW TOKEN COUNT — 1168 of 1168** ∴ the discipline generalises past tests: **an instrument that reports "nothing found" ! prove it CAN find something**|V895,V896,V897,T1006,T1064,T1068,T1095,T1123

V911|⚑⚑**`setImmediate` RESUMES ∈ THE *CHECK* PHASE ∴ A LOOP YIELDING W/ IT PASSES THROUGH *POLL* — SO SOCKET REPLIES ARE READ — & **NEVER REACHES *TIMERS***. NOTHING THAT *EXPIRES* ? FIRE ∈ A PHASE THE LOOP NEVER REACHES.** MEASURED (§T1132): **a `setInterval` SAT SILENT THROUGH AN ENTIRE 2.2 s RENDER WHILE EVERY YIELD FIRED** ∴ birpc's deadline, Vitest's OWN per-test timeout & every watchdog ∈ that family are DEAD, & **A GENUINELY HUNG RENDER STAYS UNDETECTABLE — the yield BUYS THE RPC & LOSES THE SAFETY NET.** `setTimeout(…, 0)` reaches BOTH. ⚑∴ **A GATE FOR "the loop breathes" ! WATCH *2 OBSERVERS, ONE PER PHASE*** — a loopback socket (poll, the same shape as the fork channel) AND an interval (timers) — ∵ **either alone passes a fix that is HALF RIGHT**, & §T1132's predecessor shipped exactly that half. red-verified against each degraded form: `setImmediate` fails the TIMERS half @ 2254 ms, `await Promise.resolve()` fails the POLL half @ 2514 ms. ⚠ & the counter-intuitive measurement worth keeping: **yielding MORE OFTEN WAS FASTER** — E54/3600 frames, block 35.7 s / 5.1 s / 1.0 s @ disabled / 5000 ms / 1000 ms, w/ WALLS of 36.3 / 33.8 / **25.7 s** ∴ **the yield is ⊥ paid for & the interval ? be chosen for MARGIN rather than for cost**|V63,V713,T1124,T1132

V912|⚑⚑**A FRONTIER COUNT ? RISE 3.6× W/ THE PICTURE *VISUALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE* — THE METRIC IS ⊥ THE LOOK, & E54's WHOLE HISTORY HAS BEEN STEERED BY IT.** MEASURED (§T1133): the `through opposite` aim carries **378 cross-community links against the shipped 104**, & `t1133-thruopp-f1650.png` beside `t1133-shipped-f1650.png` is **THE SAME TWO MASSES W/ THE SAME DEAD CHANNEL.** ∴ **"more frontier" & "more mixing ON SCREEN" ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS**, & 9 sessions have optimised the first while the owner kept reporting the second. ⚑the general form, & it is §V885's argument aimed @ a structure metric: **a count over PAIRS is invisible if the pairs sit where the picture already had ink** — a link between 2 points 0.05 apart inside a merged mass adds a NUMBER & NO PIXEL. ∴ **a structural metric ! be shown to MOVE THE PICTURE before it is trusted as a proxy for one**, & the cheap check is 2 renders side by side, which is what this project has had to learn 3 times (§T1074's confetti, §T1119's subtlety, this)|V885,V900,T1074,T1079,T1113,T1119,T1133
V913|⚑**§V905's SHAPE, A SECOND TIME, ON A CHANGE THAT WOULD HAVE PASSED SILENTLY: §V885's RECORDED `motion` ROW (f60–180) READ **−0.3%** WHILE THE SAME INSTRUMENT OVER THE WHOLE MINUTE READ **−30.5%**.** §T1133's `antipode of self` aim loses NEARLY A THIRD OF THE FILE'S MOTION & **THE GATE WOULD ⊥ HAVE NOTICED** — & §T1119's march priced the identical move @ −29.5% from the identical cause (**driving colonies @ the centroid COMPRESSES THE WHOLE ASSEMBLY**). ∴ **§V905 is ⊥ a one-off observation, it is a STANDING DEFECT ∈ THE BASELINE: the row samples a window inside the first draw & ? ⊥ see anything the envelope does afterwards.** the row ! either MOVE its window ∨ be joined by the whole-minute number as a PEER, ∵ *"passed the look baseline" currently means "did ⊥ change the first two seconds"*|V885,V905,T1119,T1127,T1133

V914|⚑⚑**A DRIVEN PARAMETER'S *RETAINED* VALUE ! LIE INSIDE THE RANGE THE DRIVE ACTUALLY PRODUCES — OTHERWISE *SILENCE IS LOUDER THAN THE TRACK*.** FOUND BY §T1141 ∈ ITS OWN FILE, FROM ITS OWN DUTY MEASUREMENT: E55's `laserGain` retained **1**, while the driven values measure 0.307–1.583 w/ **99% OF THEM BELOW 1** ∴ **the fallback — the value that stands when NO drive arrives — WOULD HAVE OUTSHONE EVERY AUDIO-REACTIVE FRAME.** it ships @ **0.6, the driven MEAN.** ⚑the general form & why it is §V903's sibling: **a drive lane has TWO failure modes & the duty cycle only shows ONE.** §V903 catches *"the drive never moves"*; this catches *"the drive moves, & the ABSENCE of it looks like a different, louder document"* — & absence is the COMMON case, ∵ every example opens w/ no audio, every headless render has none, & every thumbnail is captured w/o a track. ∴ **state the retained value AGAINST the measured driven distribution, ⊥ against the parameter's declared range** — the honest default is the driven MEAN ∨ MEDIAN, & a retained value outside the driven min/max is a defect ⊥ a preference|V903,V905,T1127,T1141,T1145

V915|⚑⚑**THE SEEING TOOL COSTS ~197 000 TOKENS PER CALL & THAT IS A *DEFAULT*, ⊥ A LIMIT. `render_preview` RETURNS **787 338 CHARACTERS** ON ITS DEFAULT CALL** — measured headless on Dawn against a 3-node graph. cause, & both halves are DELIBERATE: default `maxSize` is **512**, & `runtime/export/png.ts` EMITS **STORED (UNCOMPRESSED) DEFLATE BLOCKS BY DESIGN** (its own docblock says so). 512×288×4 = 589 824 B, base64 → 787 KB. **THE CURVE: 512 → 196 835 tok · 256 → 49 319 · 128 → 12 427 · 64 → 3 199 · 32 → 889.** ∴ **AN AGENT THAT *? SEE* IS PUNISHED 197 k TOKENS FOR LOOKING ONCE, & AN AGENT THAT ? ⊥ SEE TAKES A SCREENSHOT — BOTH ROADS END @ THE SAME COMPLAINT.** & the contrast is the design: `describe_output` is **588 chars**, & its description (*"Cheaper than a preview; reach for this first"*) is **TRUE BY A FACTOR OF 1 339×**. ⚑the general form: **a tool's DEFAULT is its real interface — a cheap mode nobody selects is ⊥ a cheap tool** ∴ **the cheapest USEFUL tier ! be the default & the expensive tiers ! be ASKED FOR BY NAME**, & any payload that ? reach 6 figures of tokens ! state its cost curve where the caller reads it|V39,T1097,T1115,T1146

V916|⚑⚑**A GATE THAT WALKS `document.graph` IS *SILENT ABOUT `componentLibrary`* — & TEN DRIVEN LANES LIVED THERE UNAUDITED THROUGH §T1078's ENTIRE SWEEP.** found by §T1145: `channel-integrity.test.ts` & `reference-integrity.test.ts` both read `parsed.graph` ONLY ∴ **TimeGrid's ten driven parameters INSIDE the component were invisible to every existing gate**, & the cross-boundary reads ∈ Kaleidoscope & AudioLevel were listed as *"unverifiable"* rather than checked. ⚑**THE FIX IS ⊥ AN EXEMPTION LIST, IT IS THE *FLATTENED* DOCUMENT — WHAT THE APP ACTUALLY RUNS: running the audit on the flattened graph RESOLVED ALL OF THEM & SHRANK THE EXEMPTION LIST TO NOTHING.** ∴ **any gate over "every X ∈ every shipped document" ! walk the document THE COMPILER SEES, ⊥ the one the file literally contains** — a component is a subgraph flattened @ compile, so a gate that stops @ the top level is asserting about a document THE PRODUCT NEVER RUNS. ⚠ both named gates STILL have the hole; §T1145's does ⊥|V890,T1078,T1145
V917|⚑**WHEN 2 REQUIREMENTS WANT OPPOSITE VALUES OF ONE NUMBER, *SEPARATE THE SCALES* — DO ⊥ SPLIT THE DIFFERENCE.** §T1138 measured the tension rather than guessing @ it: **a TRAIL FIELD needs MANY agents (below ~1000 per army each collapses to A SINGLE THREAD) & a k-NN WEB needs FEW (agents on a filament have all six nearest *ALONG* it ∴ A BEAD CHAIN, ⊥ A WEB)** — measured @ 3000/2400/900/600/420/250, & **NO COUNT SATISFIES BOTH.** the resolution was ⊥ a compromise count but **TWO POPULATIONS ON ONE SET: 3000 agents DEPOSIT & STEER, & `bound1` PARKS ALL BUT HALF BEFORE THE WEB IS COMPUTED.** ∴ **the simulation runs @ the density the PHYSICS wants & the drawing @ the density the EYE wants**, & neither is degraded to accommodate the other. ⚑the general form: **a single knob serving 2 masters is §V891's shape ∈ a scalar — & the answer is usually ⊥ a better value but a SECOND CONSUMER**, ∵ the two requirements were never about the same quantity ∈ the first place|V891,V900,T1074,T1138
V918|⚑⚑**AN INSTRUMENT REPORTING "NOTHING FOUND" ! PROVE IT ? HAVE FOUND SOMETHING *ON THE PATH UNDER TEST* — ⊥ ON AN ADJACENT ONE. §V910's GENERALISATION, & IT NEARLY COST §T1149 ITS ANSWER.** the spike's first 2 runs reported the video **FROZEN SOLID** — one presented frame ∈ 10 s @ every drive rate, across all 3 encodes. entirely an artefact: **Python's `http.server` IGNORES `Range` ∴ Chrome ? ⊥ SEEK, & `seeked` fired ~700×/s against a video that NEVER MOVED.** ⚑**& THE CONTROL LOOKED VALIDATED: PLAIN PLAYBACK READ A HEALTHY 30 fps** — the instrument worked perfectly on the path it was ⊥ testing. **ONLY A *SEEK-SPECIFIC* CONTROL (6 AWAITED SEEKS PRODUCING 6 DISTINCT FRAME HASHES) CAUGHT IT.** ∴ **a positive control ! EXERCISE THE MECHANISM UNDER TEST, ⊥ merely the subsystem containing it** — "the video plays" & "the video seeks" are different capabilities & the first is worthless as evidence for the second|V895,V896,V897,V910,T1149
V919|⚑**`copyExternalImageToTexture` W/ AN IMAGE *LARGER* THAN `copySize` IS LEGAL WEBGPU & COPIES THE TOP-LEFT RECTANGLE ONLY — NO ERROR, NO DIAGNOSTIC — & THIS REPO'S OWN DOCSTRING SAYS IT "asserts matching extents", WHICH IS THE WRONG READING.** `uploadExternalTextures` passes `copySize = entry.size`, NEVER the image's size ∴ **a missed ∨ wrong size field turns an atlas into "FRAME 0, CROPPED", SILENTLY** (smaller fails loudly & is caught — the asymmetry is the trap). ∴ **any gate over a packed/atlas upload ! ASSERT A PIXEL FROM A *LATE* CELL, NEVER CELL 0** — cell 0 is exactly what a total failure still produces, which makes it the one sample that ? ⊥ distinguish success from silent truncation. & the docstring ! be corrected, ∵ **anyone trusting it would never look**|V896,V897,T1149
V920|⚑⚑**COPYING A PARAMETER KEY SET COPIES ITS *DEFAULTS*, & A DEFAULT THAT IS DEAD ∈ THE SOURCE ? BE LOAD-BEARING ∈ THE DESTINATION.** MEASURED (§T1141): E55's `cut1` shipped `brightness: 0` — copied from **E35, WHERE `brightness` IS A DRIVEN SLOT & THE STATIC 0 IS NEVER READ.** ∈ E55 nothing drives it ∴ the static WAS read, & **`Level` MULTIPLIES brightness (`color.wgsl.ts:48`) ∴ THE ENTIRE BLOOM BRANCH WAS THE CORRECT SIGNAL MULTIPLIED BY ZERO** — 5 nodes rendering black, an additive composite adding nothing, & a round of art direction ("not blinded enough at the core") spent on an effect THAT WAS ⊥ THERE. ⚑the general form: **a driven parameter's static value is INERT ∈ its own document & LIVE ∈ any document that copies it W/O the drive** — so the safe unit of copying is the pair (key set + what drives it), & lifting keys alone silently promotes dead defaults into live ones. ∴ **when copying a node's parameters from another example, CHECK WHICH OF THEM THAT EXAMPLE DRIVES** — those are the ones whose statics were never true|V146,V903,V914,T1141 ⟶ ⚑**AMENDED BY §T1201, WHICH FOUND 2 FACES THIS WORDING MISSES. (a) THE HAZARD IS ⊥ ONLY "a dead default goes live" — IT IS ALSO *CALIBRATION*: E27's `offset: 0` is dead ∈ ITS OWN file (its LFO amplitude is 0 ∴ static & driven AGREE, & NOTHING WOULD HAVE FROZEN) & lifting it into E47 would have shipped an UN-FITTED lookup against a map whose 80% sits inside 0.11 of luma — **THE WHOLE PICTURE ∈ ONE STOP.** ∴ **a copied parameter ! be RE-FITTED TO THE DESTINATION'S DATA, ⊥ merely re-driven.** (b) ⚑**ONE DRIVE ? ⊥ ALWAYS SERVE TWO READERS: E47's two bands need DIFFERENT BASES ∴ a bare shared `drivenSlot` would have handed both lookups THE SAME OFFSET & COLLAPSED THE TWO-BAND FIT.** the safe unit of copying is **(key set + its drive + WHETHER THAT DRIVE IS SHAREABLE)**|

V921|⚑**A PROPERTY THAT IS *STRUCTURALLY* IMPOSSIBLE WANTS A DOCBLOCK, ⊥ A TEST — ∵ A TEST THAT ? ⊥ FAIL IS THE VACUOUS GATE §V910 WARNS ABOUT, WEARING A CLAIM.** §T1157 was told to ensure "nothing can drive" the resolution swap & correctly wrote NO gate: **neither `ProjectSettings.outputResolution` nor `GraphNode.resolution` is a `StoredParameter` ∴ no expression, binding, channel ∨ map ? reach either — THERE IS NO LEGITIMATE CASE A GUARD COULD SWALLOW.** ∴ **the honest artefact is a stated reason ∈ the code, & the honest gate would be one that fails IF THE TYPE EVER BECAME REACHABLE** — ⊥ one that asserts today's impossibility & passes forever regardless. ⚑the distinction: **"⊥ possible by construction" is a claim about A TYPE & belongs where the type is; "⊥ happening ∈ practice" is a claim about BEHAVIOUR & belongs ∈ a test.** conflating them manufactures green|V910,V916,T1157
V922|⚑⚑**SHADING ? ⊥ RESCUE A SILHOUETTE. IF THE GEOMETRY IS A SPHERE, THE OUTLINE IS A CIRCLE & EVERY HIT IS ON ONE SURFACE — *A PAPER BALL WHATEVER THE SHADING DOES*.** §T1141 chased "flat 2D sprites" through 4 rounds — Fresnel floors, lit-body terms, per-cell width, fewer cells — & each helped ∵ each was REAL, but **the residual was that the struts were A SHADING TRICK ON A PERFECT SPHERE**: no relief, no self-occlusion, no break ∈ the outline. the fix was to make them A SOLID (a signed-distance tube marched through the shell band) so they **STAND PROUD, OCCLUDE THE FACE BEHIND & BREAK THE SILHOUETTE.** ⚑& the same fact bit twice ∈ one file: **a shut shell of FLUSH plates is likewise a smooth sphere however it is lit** — it read as *"a smooth pink BALLOON"* until the ray was continued to an INSET surface. ∴ **before tuning a surface's shading, ask whether its OUTLINE & ITS SELF-OCCLUSION carry any information** — if the answer is no, no material change will read as depth, & 4 rounds of shading work will each improve something while the object stays flat|V885,V912,T1141
V923|⚑⚑**BYTE INEQUALITY IS ⊥ EVIDENCE OF MOTION ∈ A FILE THAT HAS A *SECOND, SLOWER CLOCK*.** §T1156's claim *"frames 3599 & 3600 differ"* **PASSES OVER A CAMERA FROZEN AFTER EIGHT SECONDS** — ∵ the cloud veil drifts on its own clock & keeps changing pixels while the thing the claim is ABOUT has stopped. caught by its own red-verify. ∴ **a liveliness claim ! measure THE PACE OF THE MOTION IT NAMES, ⊥ that SOMETHING changed** — & the test is: **cut the drive you care about & see if the claim still passes.** if any other animated element ? carry it, the claim is about the file rather than the feature. ⚑the family: §V912 (a frontier count rose 3.6× w/ the picture unchanged), §V913 (a window that ? ⊥ see the envelope), §V918 (a control exercising the wrong path) — **all 4 are ONE error: MEASURING AN ADJACENT QUANTITY & READING IT AS THE ONE ASKED ABOUT**|V885,V912,V913,V918,T1156

V924|⚑⚑**A LAYOUT MODEL THAT ! BE DERIVABLE FROM THE DOCUMENT ALONE ? ⊥ SIZE ITSELF TO *RUNTIME* CONTENT — ∴ "SHRINK THE BOX TO FIT WHAT'S ∈ IT" IS ⊥ ALWAYS THE RIGHT FIX; SOMETIMES THE RIGHT FIX IS A *DIFFERENT CONSTANT*.** §T1168: a value node reserved a preview slot shaped to the PROJECT's aspect & stood 362px tall ∈ portrait around a 78px plot. the obvious fix — reserve no slot, ∨ fit the plot — was REFUSED w/ a measurement: **an unsampled Mouse plot is 22px, a sampled one 62px, an LFO 78px** ∴ a content-sized slot makes **A NODE'S HEIGHT CHANGE WHEN A SIGNAL ARRIVES**, & `node-box.ts` (§V389's gate, the menu/marquee/layout model) ? only see the DOCUMENT, never the running signal. the landed fix pins a SECOND constant (`--slot-aspect: 16/9` for plot bodies) overriding the project one. ⚑the general rule: **when a box is wrong, ask whether the quantity you want to size it by is KNOWABLE ∈ the model that ! predict it** — if it is runtime state, a constant that is merely BETTER is the honest fix, & "tight to content" is a request to make the model unpredictable. ⚠& the corollary that saved this one: **the fix that LOOKS right ? break a claim that currently holds** — filling the slot w/ the plot would have made two plots disagree about full height (`value-plot.tsx:275`), which the stretched-but-fixed-canvas bug had accidentally preserved|V389,V910,T1168

V925|⚑⚑**AN SDF STEP THAT IS ⊥ A LOWER BOUND IS ⊥ AN SDF — & IT FAILS *ONLY AT GRAZING INCIDENCE*, WHICH IS WHY IT SURVIVES EVERY HEAD-ON TEST.** §T1141: the strut field used **`F2−F1` as the border distance, which is up to TWICE the true distance** ∴ the march overstepped struts & drew a SAWTOOTH on every strut edge — but only on the grazing legs, ∵ a head-on ray crosses the border ⊥ travels along it. found UNDERNEATH a cost experiment (a march floor of 1/6 the band was tried, sawtoothed, & the floor was blamed first). ⚑2 rules: **halve any Worley-difference distance before marching on it**, & **a raymarch artefact that appears when the CAMERA moves & ⊥ when the OBJECT changes is a step-size bug, ⊥ a shading one.** ⚠the meta-lesson: a performance experiment EXPOSED a correctness bug the picture had been hiding — ∴ when a cheapening knob produces an artefact, ask whether it REVEALED one rather than caused it|V885,V922,T1141

V926|⚑⚑**`wrapU` ASSERTS *ADJACENCY*; IT DOES ⊥ MAKE YOUR DATA *PERIODIC* — & THE FAILURE LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE THE HOLE THE FLAG WAS SUPPOSED TO CLOSE.** §T1169: `pointsFromTexture` reads a FLAT lattice ∴ w/ plain noise, columns 95 & 0 carry UNRELATED heights, the seam cell BRIDGES A CLIFF, & the closed tube renders **a dark vertical crevice** — the first build had it & it read as a bug ∈ surface mode. fix is ONE `mirror` on the field, asserted @ the 2 texels the lattice ACTUALLY reads (`floor(((col+0.5)/cols)*width)` → 6 & 1273): folded they agree BYTE FOR BYTE, raw they differ by up to 16/255. ⚑the general form: **closing a seam is a TOPOLOGY claim & the SIGNAL ! be made to honour it separately** — declaring adjacency on discontinuous data manufactures a visible discontinuity AT the join, & the artefact mimics the defect ∴ the author debugs the flag rather than the field. ⚠**`pointTopology`'s docstring says nothing about this & should.** SECONDARY, & it re-frames §T1167: **the node is ⊥ needed for the common case AT ALL — every one-point-per-cell generator ALREADY publishes the lattice** ∴ its real jobs are THE SEAM & re-claiming a cloud, which its description states & the catalogue never showed|V146,V903,T1071,T1167,T1169

V927|⚑⚑**A LATCH THAT PUBLISHES WHAT WAS *HANDED OVER* RATHER THAN WHAT HAS *LANDED* LIES FOR THE WHOLE LENGTH OF THE AWAIT — & AN AWAIT SHORTER THAN A FRAME IS STILL A WINDOW.** §T1163: `backend.compile` is awaited (`void backend.compile(compiled).then(…)`) while `app.tsx` latched `installedPlan` SYNCHRONOUSLY from `compile.compiled` ∴ ∈ that interval the latch advertised 6 `target:` rows to a backend HOLDING NOTHING & every preview pass bound a resource that did ⊥ exist. ⚠**IT REPRODUCED ZERO TIMES ∈ TEN CONSECUTIVE HEADED BOOTS & CPU THROTTLING ×8 DID ⊥ HELP** — the stretch is **GPU-SIDE PIPELINE COMPILATION**, which only a genuinely COLD boot pays ∴ *first boot, once per previewable node, never again that session.* ⚑2 rules: **(a) ANNOUNCE FROM INSIDE THE INSTALL, ⊥ beside the call** — the only honest publisher of "what the GPU holds" is the code that just put it there; **(b) A DEFECT THAT NEEDS A COLD CACHE ? ⊥ BE CHASED BY REPETITION — repeating the run WARMS THE THING THAT CAUSED IT.** & the gate ! OWN THE WINDOW (the backend finishes no compile until the test says so) rather than race it. ⚠the announce ! be gated on the plan SIGNATURE, ⊥ identity — a caller that rebuilds `compiled` every render otherwise spins install→setState→render→install; that is CORRECTNESS, ⊥ an optimisation|V9,V628,V910,B143,B179,T1121,T1163

V928|⚑**AN OWNER'S COUNT OF WHAT IS ON SCREEN IS A COUNT OF WHAT *FITS* ON SCREEN — TREAT A REPORTED NUMBER AS AN OBSERVATION, ⊥ A MEASUREMENT.** §T1163 shipped w/ *"5 `backend/unknown-resource` errors"* & I built a whole hypothesis on the asymmetry that **`warp` was absent** from the list. it is **SIX warnings, `warp` INCLUDED** — the pane header says `warnings 6` & the sixth row sits BELOW THE FOLD of the problems pane @ default layout. ∴ **THE ASYMMETRY I TOLD A WORKER TO CHASE NAMED NOTHING, & the second premise ("errors") was also wrong — diagnostics were ZERO throughout.** ⚑the rule: **before reasoning FROM a reported count ∨ list, REPRODUCE IT & COUNT IT YOURSELF** — a scroll boundary, a truncated log ∨ a collapsed row manufactures a false pattern, & a false pattern is worse than no pattern ∵ it is SPECIFIC & directs the search. same family as §V923: measuring an adjacent quantity & reading it as the one asked about|V910,V923,T1163

V929|⚑⚑**ONE CALIBRATION REFERENCE IS ⊥ ENOUGH, & THE PAIRED-DIFFERENCE INSTRUMENT IS *BIASED* UNDER BURSTY LOAD — IT SYSTEMATICALLY FLATTERS THE CHEAP CONFIG.** §T1166 named what §T1156 missed: the LO/HI difference needs **BOTH** runs ∈ a quiet gap, & **A CHEAP CONFIG'S SHORTER RUN FITS ∈ A GAP WHERE A DEAR ONE'S DOES ⊥** ∴ the dear side eats the burst. ONE BLOCK read **E13 @ 3.93 (right) & E57 @ 20.45 — 3× its recorded value — ∈ THE SAME ALTERNATION** ∴ a single reference reading correct DOES ⊥ certify the block. **CARRY 2 REFERENCES OF DIFFERENT COST & REQUIRE BOTH TO LAND NEAR RECORD BEFORE KEEPING A NUMBER**; if only the cheap one calibrates, the expensive measurement ∈ that block is unusable. corroborated same day by an independent session: an UNTOUCHED shader read 54 ms & the same shot swung 16→52 ms between identical runs, & a peer's "+5 ms for a feature" evaporated to **+0.1 ms** when re-measured w/ a control ∈ THE SAME RUN. ⚑∴ **THE CONTROL ! BE ∈ THE SAME RUN AS THE MEASUREMENT, & ⊥ WAITING FOR A QUIET MACHINE — quiet ? never arrive & ? ⊥ be proven.** ⚠& do ⊥ diagnose load from `ps %cpu`: the same PID read 53.2 & then 0.0 seconds apart, & 4 processes blamed for "running the GPU all day" were STATIC FILE SERVERS @ 0.0%|V146,V147,V923,T1150,T1156,T1166 ⚛**REFINEMENT (§T1248, measured): the window condition is STABILITY, ⊥ A THRESHOLD.** a watcher written as `until load < 1.8` waits FOREVER on a real desktop — the load on this box did ⊥ decay, it sat @ a FLOOR of ~3.4 (WindowServer 37–51 %, FSEvents 29–36 %, the owner's Chrome & Terminal, & the Claude sessions themselves; an ORCHESTRATOR session was the SECOND-largest consumer @ 36.6 %). the honest condition: SAMPLE UNTIL THE 1-MINUTE AVERAGE STOPS MOVING, then run BOTH ARMS ALTERNATED against that same floor. that buys a VALID PAIR — the DELTA under one machine state, which is what a before/after row asks for. it does ⊥ buy a clean ABSOLUTE: 0.068 ms/rAF on a 3.4 floor is ⊥ the same 0.068 ms on an idle box ∴ **report the target met-or-not ON THE DELTA & say plainly that the absolutes carry ambient load & ⊥ ! be compared across machines.** a before-arm & an after-arm taken an hour apart ∈ different machine states are ⊥ A PAIR — this invariant's own failure, one level up

V930|⚑**THE TEXTBOOK `tanh` OVERFLOWS f32 & NaN RENDERS *BLACK* ∴ RAISING EXPOSURE ? *DARKEN* A PIXEL.** §T1166: `tanh` as `(e^2x−1)/(e^2x+1)` overflows past 2x≈88, `Inf/Inf` is NaN, & **6 channels went 255→0 @16× gain.** caught by a claim phrased as a MONOTONICITY — *"raising exposure may darken no pixel"* — ⊥ by any output comparison. clamped @16, verified against a clamp @40 to change **ZERO bytes @1× & @4×** ∴ the guard swallows no legitimate case (CLAUDE.md's bar: exercise the case the guard could eat). ⚑the general form worth reusing: **a tone-mapper's contract is MONOTONIC, & a monotonicity claim catches overflow, NaN & clamping bugs that a golden-image comparison @ one exposure ? ⊥ see.** & the sibling found the same way: **a vessel measured ∈ WORLD space while the warp TRAVELS grows w/o limit & seals shut MINUTES ∈** — a claim that only runs for 180 frames ? ⊥ see it; measure eye-relative|V146,V903,V913,T880,T1166

V931|⚑⚑**A *VALUE-ONLY* SWEEP PASSES EVERY CHECK THAT LOOKS FOR FOREIGN *KEYS*.** §T1141's `46a0f17` carried the Forest track's RE-MEASURED E57 numbers ∈ `look-baselines.json` — **SAME KEYS, CHANGED NUMBERS** — & the author's per-commit check grepped the diff for foreign KEY NAMES ∴ saw nothing. (`2d83c89` restored E57's HEAD values; the other track's working tree untouched, nothing lost.) ⚑**THE GENERAL FORM & IT IS §B184's SHARPER SIBLING: A SHARED *DATA* FILE IS SWEPT BY MUTATION AS WELL AS BY ADDITION** — a baseline, a snapshot, a lockfile, a generated table. an added row ANNOUNCES ITSELF; **A CHANGED NUMBER ∈ AN EXISTING ROW LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE YOUR OWN RE-MEASUREMENT.** ∴ **CHECK BY BLOCK, ⊥ BY KEY: a hunk header's context names the row it edits, so read the HUNKS & confirm every one names something you own** — & for a file of per-example rows, the rows you may touch are the examples ∈ your own commit, full stop|V146,V903,B184,T1141,T1156,T1166

V932|⚑**A PIXELWISE MONOTONICITY CLAIM ! NEUTRALISE EVERY *NON-MONOTONE* STAGE DOWNSTREAM OF THE THING IT MEASURES, ∨ IT ASSERTS THE GRADE RATHER THAN THE EFFECT.** §T1141: *"no pixel is brighter without bloom"* failed on 6 pixels — **an HSV SATURATION BOOST AFTER THE COMPOSITE IS ⊥ MONOTONE ∈ LUMA** (a pale bloom DESATURATES a blue pixel; re-saturating it LOWERS its luma) ∴ adding light made 6 pixels darker & the claim was true about the pipeline & false about the bloom. fix: both shots neutralise the grade, & the claim is now ABOUT THE BLOOM. ⚑the family w/ §V930 (`tanh` overflow caught BY a monotonicity claim): **monotonicity is the sharpest cheap claim available & it is exactly as sharp as the path it measures is clean** — assert it on the SHORTEST path that contains the effect, ⊥ on the final frame|V146,V903,V910,V930,T1141

V933|⚑⚑**POSITION ∈ AN ALTERNATION IS ⊥ NEUTRAL — *THE ROW AFTER THE REFERENCE EATS THE REFERENCE'S TAIL*.** §T1171 measured it: **∈ 5 of 6 blocks the file placed SECOND read ~25% ABOVE its true cost, & REVERSING THE ORDER MOVED THE INFLATION ONTO WHICHEVER FILE WAS THEN SECOND.** ∴ alternating A/B/A/B does ⊥ cancel the bias — it PINS it to a slot. ⚑**THE STRONGER INSTRUMENT, & IT BEAT THE EXTERNAL REFERENCE ON A CONTENDED MACHINE: A *CONTROL GROUP* OF FILES THAT **MUST** COST THE SAME.** E58/E59/E60/E62 all march 72 steps × 6 octaves ∴ **THEIR SPREAD *IS* THE BLOCK'S ERROR BAR, MEASURED FROM THE INSIDE W/ NO APPEAL TO A RECORDED FIGURE** — & it certified a 1080p block to **5.4%** that E13 REJECTED @+26%. ∴ **WHEN A REFERENCE REFUSES TO CALIBRATE, LOOK FOR THINGS ∈ THE MEASUREMENT ITSELF THAT ARE REQUIRED TO BE EQUAL** ⊥ wait for quiet. corroborates §V929 & supersedes its "two references" rule where a control group exists. ⚠& §V912's warning applies to the ratios: **9 octaves vs 6 read 1.51× where the arithmetic predicts 1.50 — a MATCH THAT GOOD ON A CONTENDED MACHINE IS ITSELF EVIDENCE THE BLOCK WAS CLEAN**, ⊥ a coincidence to average over|V146,V912,V923,V929,T1156,T1166,T1171

V934|⚑⚑**PROFILE SHARES ARE ⊥ ADDITIVE: FIXING THE BIGGEST THING *CHANGES WHAT EVERYTHING ELSE IS WORTH*, ∴ A SURVEY'S PERCENTAGES ARE A CLAIM ABOUT THE TREE IT MEASURED & EXPIRE THE MOMENT YOU EDIT IT.** §T1172: *"parse is 82% of expression cost"* was TRUE when surveyed & worth **−2% to −7%** when A/B'd ∈ the END STATE — the target memo had ALREADY removed the repetition parse was being blamed for. meanwhile reflection paid **−62% ⊥ the surveyed 38%**, & the name index — filed as a footnote — was **THE SECOND-BIGGEST WIN (−62% on chain40)**. ∴ **RE-MEASURE EACH FIX ∈ THE STATE THE PREVIOUS FIX LEFT, ⊥ against the original profile**, & land them separately so each carries its OWN number. ⚑the corollary that matters for judgement: **a fix whose share collapsed is ⊥ thereby WRONG** — keep it if it still pays beyond control drift, but report it honestly as small rather than quoting the survey figure that sold it|V910,V912,V929,V933,T1156,T1172,T1176

V935|⚑⚑**A MEMO KEYED ON "THE DOCUMENT" IS WRONG WHEREVER THE DOCUMENT IS STILL BEING *WRITTEN*.** §T1172 was told to cache the graph name index per REVISION & correctly refused: **`apply-patch.ts` calls `nodeNames` on an immer *DRAFT IT IS STILL MUTATING*, & 2 `addNode` ops ∈ ONE PATCH REQUIRE THE SECOND `uniqueNodeName` TO SEE THE FIRST ADD** ∴ a revision- ∨ identity-keyed memo returns a stale index & MINTS A DUPLICATE NAME (§V127). the index went ∈ THE READER instead — a scope that ? ⊥ outlive the read — & a gate red-verified w/ the tempting `WeakMap<GraphDocument>` keeps the wrong fix out. ⚑**THE FAMILY, & IT IS THE 2ND TIME TODAY: §T1174 keyed a ValuePlot memo on THE DOCUMENT OBJECT rather than `graph.revision` ∵ A SAVED `.loom.json` *RESTORES* THE REVISION IT WAS SAVED AT ∴ 2 FILES ? COLLIDE ON ONE NUMBER.** ∴ **before keying a memo, ask 2 things: ? THE KEY REPEAT (a restored revision), & ? THE VALUE CHANGE WHILE THE KEY DOES ⊥ (a draft mid-mutation).** either answer yes ⟶ that key is a stale-value bug wearing a cache|V29,V127,V910,T1172,T1174

V936|⚑⚑**BEFORE SKIPPING AN EXPENSIVE CHECK ON THE STRENGTH OF A CLASSIFICATION, ASK WHETHER *THAT CHECK IS WHAT MAKES THE CLASSIFICATION SAFE*.** §T1176: I specified short-circuiting the compile for `uniform-update` edits. the worker refused w/ the structure: **`use-frame-loop.ts:607` pushes uniforms only after `animator.push` asserts `isUniformOnlyChange` AGAINST THE FRESHLY COMPILED PLAN & falls through to `backend.compile` when they disagree** ∴ the compile IS the net — & the classifier NEEDS it, ∵ `classifyEdit` calls every non-`compileTime` parameter edit `uniform-update` **w/o consulting `outputWhen`/`msaaWhen`, both of which read `node.parameters` & change plan STRUCTURE.** the classification is ⊥ sound; it is CHECKED. ⚑**THE GENERAL FORM: A CHEAP CLASSIFIER + AN EXPENSIVE VERIFIER IS A CORRECT DESIGN, & IT LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE A REDUNDANT EXPENSIVE STEP.** deleting the verifier does ⊥ expose a latent bug — **IT CREATES ONE, & silently** (§B179's shape: the app renders a stale plan while the frame counter advances). ∴ the sound optimisation keeps the verifier & makes it CHEAP (splice + compare structure keys + fall through), ⊥ removes it. **A FAST PATH ? BE WRONG AS LONG AS IT DETECTS THAT IT IS & PAYS THE FULL PRICE**|V910,B179,T1121,T1176,T1182

V937|⚑⚑**A *CALL* COUNT IS ⊥ A *RETAINED* COUNT, & FOR A LEAK ONLY THE SECOND IS THE OBSERVABLE.** §T1174 measured **49 new `createBindGroup` calls per identical cycle** & filed it as the leak rate. §T1180 showed the number is ~FLAT WHETHER ∨ ⊥ ANYTHING IS EVICTED — a rebuilt program mints new bind groups either way — **∴ IT ? ⊥ SHOW THE FIX WORKING, & THE TRUE LEAK WAS 12/CYCLE: 37 OF THE 49 WERE ALREADY BEING RECLAIMED.** the right instrument: hold every returned object by `WeakRef`, drop the mock's own descriptor arrays, force GC, & **COUNT WHAT SURVIVES** — that is what the cache still holds. ⚑**& THE MIS-OBSERVABLE HID THE ACTUAL BUG: a retained-BY-LABEL histogram put 100% of the growth on ONE LONG-LIVED OBJECT (`preview-composite`), ⊥ on the discarded ones everybody assumed** — & the mechanism was **AN EVICTION SUBSCRIPTION THAT FOLLOWS THE BINDING *SLOT* RATHER THAN THE CACHE *ENTRY***: rotating one slot over N resources keeps N entries subscribed to ONE. ∴ **when a leak's mechanism is assumed, LABEL WHAT SURVIVES & LET THE HISTOGRAM NAME THE OWNER** — the fix aimed at the assumed cause moved ZERO numbers, & was measured doing so before the real one was found|V8,V910,V929,T1174,T1180

V938|⚑**THE CHEAPEST PATH IS SOMETIMES ALSO THE *CORRECT* ONE — & when it is, that is the argument, ⊥ the milliseconds.** §T1178: the shader editor rebuilt a fresh markers array & dispatched a `setDiagnostics` transaction **PER KEYSTROKE, EVEN W/ ZERO DIAGNOSTICS**. memoising it took a keystroke 2.12 → 0.059 ms (the FLOOR — a bare line-start scan is 0.058), **but the real gain is that CodeMirror now MAPS THE EXISTING RANGES THROUGH THE EDIT: a marker MOVES W/ THE TEXT ABOVE IT rather than being RE-LAID FROM LINE NUMBERS COMPUTED ON A SOURCE THE USER HAS ALREADY CHANGED.** the old path was ⊥ merely wasteful, it was RE-DERIVING POSITIONS FROM STALE INPUT every keystroke. ⚑∴ **when a per-tick recompute is proposed for removal, ask what the framework would do INSTEAD — if the framework's own incremental path is more correct than your recompute, the memo is a CORRECTNESS fix that happens to be faster**, & it should be argued & GATED that way (§T1178 gates marker IDENTITY across keystrokes, ⊥ elapsed time)|V16,V910,V934,T1178

V939|⚑⚑**A MEMO BOUNDARY ROUND A THING THAT READS *OTHER* THINGS ? ⊥ BE KEYED ON THAT THING'S OWN IDENTITY — & THE INSPECTOR IS THE PROOF.** §T1177: I specified *"resolve on its own node's revision"*. **`haze1`'s 20 parameters read `op('reactor1').par.<key>` ∴ TURNING `reactor1` MOVES ALL TWENTY DISPLAYED VALUES WHILE `haze1`'s OWN NODE OBJECT IS BYTE-UNCHANGED** — the local key is stale BY CONSTRUCTION, & the memo would have frozen a whole inspector pane on a document where cross-node references are the point. ⚑**THE ESCAPE, & IT GENERALISES: COMPARE THE *RESOLVED VALUES* RATHER THAN ANY KEY — a claim that ? ⊥ GO STALE ∵ IT CACHES NOTHING.** it costs a comparison instead of a lookup & it is CORRECT under arbitrary indirection. ∴ **when choosing a memo key, ask WHAT THE RENDER READS, ⊥ WHAT IT IS ABOUT** — if the answer includes anything reached by reference, no identity local to the subject is admissible. w/ §V935 this is the pair: **§V935 asks whether the KEY ? repeat ∨ go stale; §V939 asks whether the key ? SEE EVERYTHING THE VALUE DEPENDS ON.**|V16,V910,V935,T1172,T1177

V940|⚑⚑**A VALIDATION THAT REJECTS *AFTER* A PARSE HAS ALREADY CONSUMED THE TEXT ERASES THE EVIDENCE OF THE MISTAKE — PUT THE ARITY CHECK *W/* THE STRIP, ⊥ DOWNSTREAM OF IT.** §T1184's first cut split them: `// @default [1, 0]` on a `vec3f` was CONSUMED by the parser & then REFUSED by the shaper ∴ **the annotation vanished from the help text *AND* from the default — a typo that erases its own evidence**, which is the exact silence the task existed to remove. shipped rule: **a literal that ? ⊥ mean anything for the type IS ⊥ A DECLARATION — nothing is stripped, & the author reads their own typo back ∈ the control's help.** ⚠**& refusing the COMPILE was rejected for a reason worth reusing: THE EDITOR RECOMPILES PER KEYSTROKE ∴ a hard refusal BLACKS THE NODE OUT MID-TYPING** — an authoring surface ! stay legible through invalid intermediate states, ∵ every valid state is reached THROUGH them. ⚑the general form: **when a parser & a validator disagree about a fragment, the parser ! ⊥ have eaten it first** — & the test of the design is whether A BAD INPUT STILL SHOWS THE USER WHAT THEY WROTE|V147,V910,V938,T880,T1053,T1059,T1184

V941|⚑⚑**"RESET" & "FRESH" ! BE THE SAME STATE, & IF TWO ENTRANCES TO THE SYSTEM RUN DIFFERENT RITES THEY WILL DISAGREE SILENTLY — W/ EVERY GATE LIVING ON THE ENTRANCE THAT DOES LESS.** §B186: `clearTemporalHistory` cleared to the target's own `clearColor`, which vgpu DEFAULTS to `[0,0,0,1]`, while a freshly allocated texture reads back **alpha 0** ∴ a reset pair was OPAQUE & a new one TRANSPARENT — & alpha was the re-seed FLAG. **`renderHeadless` never called §T552's load rite, so OFFLINE ALWAYS STARTED FRESH & THE APP ALWAYS STARTED CLEARED**: every gate in the project was green on the path that never exercised the difference. ⚑2 rules: **(a) A CLEAR ! REPRODUCE THE ALLOCATION STATE ∈ *EVERY* CHANNEL — §T764's probe checked RGB & missed alpha, which is where the information was; (b) WHEREVER A PRODUCT ENTRANCE RUNS A RITE, THE TEST HARNESS ! BE ABLE TO RUN IT TOO, & SOMETHING ! ASSERT THE TWO ENTRANCES AGREE.** the shipped form of (b) is the strongest claim available here: **RENDER WITH THE RITE & WITHOUT IT & REQUIRE THE RESULTS TO BE *BYTE-IDENTICAL* — exact, ⊥ thresholded, ∵ THEY ARE MEANT TO BE THE SAME STATE**|V147,V854,V910,T552,T650,T764,B186

V942|⚑⚑**AN INSTRUMENT THAT MEASURES *WHERE* SOMETHING GOES IS BLIND TO *WHETHER IT MOVES*.** §T1190: the worker's position map had **ZERO clamp-pinning & a perfectly even coverage histogram** — & still looked frozen to the owner. duty & coverage both answer *"is the range being used?"*; the complaint was *"is the picture changing?"*. **AN EVENLY-COVERED RANGE VISITED ∈ LONG STATIC HOLDS SCORES PERFECTLY ON BOTH & IS EXACTLY THE DEFECT.** the instrument that ⊥ lie is **THE LONGEST RUN ON ONE VALUE** (109 frames → 5 across the fix). ⚑the family w/ §V923/§V912/§V913/§V918: **measuring an adjacent quantity & reading it as the one asked about** — & the tell here is that the worker's metric was DERIVED FROM THE DESIGN (a position map naturally invites a position histogram) rather than from THE COMPLAINT. ∴ **BUILD THE INSTRUMENT FROM THE USER'S SENTENCE, ⊥ FROM YOUR MECHANISM.** ⚑& the structural half worth keeping: **AN ABSOLUTE-POSITION MAPPING MAKES A CONSTANT INPUT A CONSTANT FRAME ∴ FREEZES ARE STRUCTURAL & ⊥ TUNABLE** — every smoothing stage flattens the signal & a flat signal on a position map IS a still. **DRIVING A *RATE* (`x += f(sig)·dt`) MAKES A CONSTANT INPUT MEAN CONSTANT MOTION**, which is why it ? ⊥ corner itself|V147,V912,V913,V918,V923,T1155,T1190

V943|⚑**AN ASSET THAT WILL BE *SCRUBBED* NEEDS A SHORT GOP, & THE DEFAULT ENCODE GIVES YOU THE OPPOSITE.** §T1190: I encoded E56's clip for SIZE & shipped **2 KEYFRAMES ∈ 496 FRAMES** ∴ a random seek had to decode from far away — **median 32.5 ms, p90 50.8, against a 16.7 ms FRAME BUDGET, so THE DECODER WOULD HAVE SET THE UPDATE RATE** & no amount of value-graph work could have made the picture keep up. **12-frame GOP: 4.5 / 5.7 / 7.6 ms @ 2.92 MB** — all-intra measured & rejected (5.1–12.3 MB). ∴ **when a clip's playhead is DRIVEN rather than played, seek latency is a FIRST-CLASS budget & `-g` is a required parameter, ⊥ a default** — & the measurement to take is a MEDIAN RANDOM SEEK ∈ the real browser, ⊥ the file size|V146,V147,T1155,T1190

V944|⚑⚑**A SIGNATURE BUILT FOR ONE CONSUMER IS A LIE TO EVERY OTHER CONSUMER THAT BORROWS IT.** §B188: `planStructureSignature` exists so the vgpu backend knows when to rebuild its GPU PROGRAM, ∴ it names resources & passes & NOTHING ELSE — correctly, ∵ §V5 requires it to be blind to uniform VALUES. **but `use-frame-loop` borrowed it to decide *"is this a new plan worth announcing"*, & a SYNTHESIZED PREVIEW mints NEITHER a resource NOR a pass** ∴ **2 plans differing ONLY ∈ `outputs[].synthesis` HAVE BYTE-IDENTICAL SIGNATURES** (measured: E47 w/ & w/o preview sinks, 30 resources / 37 passes both) & the second was NEVER INSTALLED INTO REACT STATE. ⚠**& THE SAME BORROWING PUT THE BUG *INSIDE THE DEBUG SCREEN BUILT TO CATCH IT*: §T1188's `pipeline-model.ts:159` decides "the installed plan is behind" w/ that same comparison ∴ IT REPORTS "∈ SYNC" THROUGHOUT.** ⚑the rule: **before reusing a signature/hash/key, ask WHAT IT WAS BUILT TO BE INSENSITIVE TO — a good key is DEFINED by what it ignores, & every ignored field is a defect waiting for the second consumer.** ∴ **a staleness check ! be derived from what the CONSUMER reads** (here: `outputs`, synthesis included), ⊥ from the nearest existing hash|V5,V9,V910,V937,B179,B188,T1121,T1163,T1188

V945|⚑⚑**A CONTROL WHOSE DISPLAYED VALUE COMES FROM THE *DEFINITION* RATHER THAN THE *GRAPH* IS WRITE-ONLY — & IT LOOKS PERFECT WHEREVER THE AUTHORED DEFAULT HAPPENS TO EQUAL THE STORED VALUE.** §T1192: a component's published knob rendered `defaultParameterValue(published.definition)`, a CONSTANT ∴ turning Resolution to 64 set `grid.cols` to 64 **while the slider snapped back to 128**. ⚑**IT SHIPPED ∵ E47's AUTHORED DEFAULT EQUALS ITS STORED VALUE — the one document anybody tested it on ? ⊥ show the defect.** §B8's shape (a suite that never exercises the driven case) & §B181's (26 green tests, every one resolving a STATIC) ∈ a THIRD costume. ∴ **2 rules: (a) A CONTROL'S DISPLAYED VALUE ! COME BACK THROUGH THE SAME RESOLVER THE ENGINE READS (§V61's one path), NEVER FROM A SCHEMA; (b) A GATE ON A CONTROL ! USE A FIXTURE WHOSE STORED VALUE *DIFFERS* FROM ITS DEFAULT — equality is the case that hides everything.** the general form: **write-only is invisible to any test that only writes, & to any document that never diverged**|V29,V61,V910,V920,V939,B8,B181,T1184,T1192

V946|⚑⚑**A CLAIM THAT DRIVES A PARAMETER TO ITS *EXTREMES* PASSES CHEERFULLY THROUGH A MIS-CALIBRATION OF THE *MIDDLE* — & THE MIDDLE IS WHERE THE FILE SHIPS.** §B189: E47's existing §T977 claim drove the matte to BOTH its extremes & **both extremes worked throughout the defect** ∴ nothing caught that the SHIPPED window (0.6±0.1) sat where **exactly 0 of 25600 live points was ever fully cut** & the whole effect was a **2.3% dim**. the threshold had been calibrated against a depth map that is ⊥ the one the example feeds. ⚑**∴ AN OPERATOR'S GATE ! ASSERT SOMETHING TRUE AT *THE SHIPPED SETTING*, ⊥ ONLY THAT THE KNOB HAS AUTHORITY** — "it does everything @ 0 and everything @ 1" says the wiring is live & says NOTHING about whether the file works. ⚑**& THE INSTRUMENT THAT FOUND IT IS REUSABLE: render ONCE @ threshold 0.5 / feather 0.5 TO MAKE `smoothstep` INVERTIBLE, & RECOVER THE INPUT'S DISTRIBUTION ∈ THE MATTE'S OWN SPACE.** then a threshold is CHOSEN AGAINST THE DATA (here: the empty gap between a bed @ [0.60,0.65] & an orb @ 1.0) rather than by eye. **a threshold w/o its histogram is a guess that survives every extremes test**|V147,V910,V923,V942,B189,T977

V947|⚑⚑**A COMMAND ? REPORT `applied` & DO NOTHING — & A CENSUS THAT SEES *HOLDERS* IS BLIND TO IT.** §T1195 named a third mechanism nobody had: **the per-bus STORE splits ∈ two.** a root command writes one store while the canvas is subscribed to the session bus's ∴ `ui.toggleEdgeFlow` flipped `true` on the root & the canvas never saw it — **`applied`, & nothing happened.** ⚠**dual-registration, which fixes the HOLDER mechanism, is the WRONG fix here: it would split the STATE instead of the handler.** ⚑& the general rule the row earns: **A DERIVED GATE IS ONLY AS WIDE AS THE THING IT ENUMERATES.** §T1195's gate walks `bus.listCommands()` & compares dry-run answers across a dive — genuinely derived, genuinely found a surface nobody had listed — **& it still ? ⊥ see a command whose handler runs correctly against the wrong STATE.** ∴ **when a derived gate lands, WRITE DOWN WHAT IT ⊥ COVER, ∈ the gate**, ∨ its greenness will be read as coverage it never had (§V910's family, §T1175's exactly)|V910,V453,V123,T969,T1175,T1195

V948|⚑⚑**A LIST NAMED AFTER ONE OF ITS MEMBERS LOSES THE OTHERS — & A DOCBLOCK NAMING THE UNFIXED SURFACE IS ⊥ A FIX.** §T1195: the registry of buses that doors dispatch on was called **`selectionBuses`** ∴ when `view.frameAll` & `ui.openNodeSearch` needed the same treatment, nobody looked ∈ a list about SELECTION. renamed **`doorBuses`** — named for WHAT IT IS, ⊥ for its first member. ⚑⚑**& the harder half: §T969(b) fixed this exact mechanism ONE EFFECT ABOVE, & ITS OWN DOCBLOCK SAYS *"the same shape as `graph.selectAll` and `view.frameAll`"* — WHILE `view.frameAll` WAS STILL BROKEN. THE RULE WAS WRITTEN DOWN, THE SIBLING WAS NAMED BY NAME, & THE NAMED SIBLING WAS THE ONE LEFT UNFIXED.** ∴ **"the same shape as X" ∈ a comment is a TODO wearing a fact's clothes: EITHER FIX X ∈ THE SAME COMMIT ∨ FILE IT** — & §V437's older form of this (*a property delivered site by site is ⊥ delivered*) now has its sharpest instance|V437,V453,V910,T969,T1195

V949|⚑⚑**A SINGLE-LABEL CLASSIFICATION *W/ PRECEDENCE* THROWS AWAY MOST OF WHAT IT KNOWS — & THE COST IS ARITHMETIC, ⊥ AESTHETIC.** §T1162 measured it on the shipped corpus: **15 examples close a temporal loop & only *3* wear the `feedback` category; 26 carry a point system & only *6* wear `points`.** the classifier was never wrong — it was FORCED TO PICK ONE, & precedence discarded the rest. ⚑**∴ WHEN A FACET IS COMPUTED PER ITEM & THEN COLLAPSED TO ONE VALUE, THE INFORMATION IS ALREADY THERE & THE UI IS THE ONLY THING DISCARDING IT** — the fix is ⊥ a second taxonomy but **THE SAME TABLE READ TWICE** (`categoryOf` became literally *"the first medium tag"*: one table, two readings, no second list to keep ∈ step). ⚠**& the trap on the other side, refused ∈ the same row: a facet vocabulary that names EVERY node type is "lists the node types" wearing a friendlier name.** 10 rows covering 37 types beat a 104-entry map. **the test of a good tag is that A PERSON WOULD FILTER BY IT**, ⊥ that it is derivable|V453,V748,V910,T728,T846,T1162

V950|⚑⚑**A MOUNT-TIME DECISION IS MADE *ONCE*, & SWAPPING WHAT A COMPONENT DISPLAYS W/O REMOUNTING IT SILENTLY KEEPS EVERY ONE OF THEM.** §T1195: `<ReactFlow fitView>` fits ON MOUNT; a component dive hands the SAME pane a NEW `graph` prop & remounts nothing ∴ **the camera stays pointed @ coordinates the new graph has never heard of.** ⚑the diagnostic question that generalises: **"WHAT ELSE DID THIS COMPONENT DECIDE AT MOUNT, & IS THAT DECISION STILL TRUE OF WHAT IT IS SHOWING NOW?"** — *diving is the only navigation ∈ this app that changes WHICH GRAPH you are looking at W/O CHANGING WHAT IS LOOKING AT IT*, which is why it collects this whole family (§B188's latch, §T1195's 3 mechanisms, this). ⚠**& the paired trap: THE FIX ITSELF ? FIRE AGAINST THE OLD SUBJECT.** the dive moves `componentPath` & `graph` ∈ one commit while the view library catches up ∈ its own ∴ an eager re-fit **FRAMES THE PARENT'S NODES PERFECTLY & REPORTS SUCCESS.** ∴ **a corrective action taken on a prop change ! VERIFY IT ACTED ON THE NEW SUBJECT — by COUNTING what it covered, ⊥ by trusting that it ran** (§V123: a fit silently ignores what it does ⊥ know)|V123,V910,V947,B188,T1195

V951|⚑⚑**READ THE HEADER OF THE FILE YOU ARE ABOUT TO CHANGE — BOTH OF §B189's PROPOSED FIXES VIOLATED A CONSTRAINT *WRITTEN DOWN ∈ THE FILE THE FIX WOULD HAVE EDITED*.** I proposed premultiplying ∈ `mask`; **`composite.wgsl.ts`'s OWN HEADER states the catalogue's alpha convention — straight, *"every node in this catalogue that writes alpha writes it straight"* — & `PORTER_DUFF_WGSL` ENFORCES IT BY DIVIDING THE PREMULTIPLY BACK OUT** ∴ the carve would have been UNDONE BY THE FIRST `over` DOWNSTREAM: a fix that renders correctly ∈ isolation & wrong ∈ every composite. I also proposed rewiring to `multiply`; **a component's boundary port names DERIVE FROM ITS INTERIOR DANGLING PORTS ∴ that rename would have silently renamed an EXPOSED port another document wires BY NAME.** ⚑the shipped answer was a **DECLARED, OPT-IN EXCEPTION NAMED ∈ THAT SAME HEADER** — which is how you change a convention w/o falsifying it. ∴ **a cross-cutting convention lives ∈ prose next to the code that enforces it; grep is ⊥ enough & a plausible one-line change is exactly the shape that breaks one.** & the corollary for BOUNDARY names: **anything DERIVED from an interior detail is a PUBLIC name the moment a document wires it**|V146,V910,V920,V948,B189,T956,T1194,T1201

V952|⚑⚑**`valueNormalize` ALONE DOES ⊥ BUY "⊥ FLICKERY" — A PERCENTILE *STEEPENS THE MAP WHERE THE SIGNAL IS DENSE*, SO A SMOOTH INPUT COMES OUT AS A JUMP.** §T1170 measured it: **`airRank1` moved 20.9% OF ITS SPAN ∈ ONE FRAME (1257%/s)** on an input that was already lagged. ⚠**& LENGTHENING THE INPUT LAG ? ⊥ FIX IT — THE INPUT WAS ⊥ THE ROUGH THING, THE *MAP* WAS.** the fix is **A SECOND FOLLOWER *AFTER* THE RANK: 20.9% → 2.09%** (8.6% → 0.78% on the other lane) for about a tenth of the tail coverage. ∴ **the shape is `signal → lag → NORMALIZE → lag → drive`, & the second lag is ⊥ optional** — it is what §T1190's percentile argument left out. ⚑**& A SECOND LIMIT ON THE SAME NODE: A PERCENTILE REMOVES *SKEW* BUT ? ⊥ SPREAD A *TIE*.** `audioPattern`'s `:level` RESTS AT ITS FLOOR ∴ 18.9% of the run landed ∈ the bottom twentieth even after ranking; `:lowMid` ranks nearly flat. **∴ CHANNEL CHOICE IS A MEASUREMENT, ⊥ a preference** — rank the channel that actually moves|V147,V910,V929,V942,T1155,T1170,T1190

V953|⚑⚑**A CLAIM'S STATISTIC ? SURVIVE THE EDIT THAT INVALIDATES IT — & THE ONES THAT BREAK LOUDLY ARE THE LUCKY HALF.** §T1170 changed E57's lighting & **THREE existing claims changed meaning w/o any of them being about lighting**: *"cut the walk & the picture stops"* broke ∵ the newly-added audio is A THIRD CLOCK (§V923 again); the clumping dispersion **INVERTED** (0.103 clumped vs 0.174 even) ∵ it is A COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION & the god rays raise the MEAN more than the spread; & ⚑**the headline-corner contrast ratio went 0.48 → 0.72, PAST ITS BOUND — A LIGHTING CHANGE SILENTLY DEGRADED A *COMPOSITION* REQUIREMENT, & ONLY THE MEASURED VERSION NOTICED.** ∴ 2 rules: **(a) A NORMALISED STATISTIC (ratio, CV, per-mean anything) MOVES WHEN ITS DENOMINATOR MOVES — prefer one measured where the change does ⊥ reach** (here: pixels the wood draws NOTHING on, byte-identical w/ the effect off); **(b) A CLAIM THAT STILL PASSES AFTER AN UNRELATED EDIT IS ⊥ THEREBY STILL *ABOUT* WHAT IT SAYS** — §V946's sibling. **re-derive a claim's premise when you change the picture it measures, ⊥ only when it goes red**|V147,V910,V923,V942,V946,T1170
V954|⚑⚑**`floor(x / n * n)` IS ⊥ `x` — A FRAME INDEX THAT ROUND-TRIPS THROUGH SECONDS ! BE RECOVERED W/ AN EPSILON *INSIDE* THE FLOOR, & THE FAILURE IS INVISIBLE ON EVERYTHING BUT A ONE-FRAME EVENT.** §B194: `(frame / fps) * fps` sits one ulp under `frame` on ~1% of frames; a level lane reads the neighbouring record & nobody sees; a COUNT lane, 1 on one record, loses the event outright — the snare that never flashed. ∴ any lookup keyed on a frame recovered from a time (`mediaPlayhead`, `timeSeconds`, the pre-analysis track, `cache.index`) floors `t·fps + ε` w/ ε ≪ 1 frame, & its test WALKS EVERY FRAME ∈ a range rather than sampling — the bad frames are ⊥ where a sample lands. the general form: A LOSSY ROUND-TRIP THROUGH A UNIT CONVERSION ! ⊥ FEED A DISCONTINUOUS FUNCTION W/O A GUARD BAND. see §V45 (determinism), §T1229
V955|⚑**A MUTE-BASED REACTIVITY CLAIM CANNOT SURVIVE THE NORMALISER: A CONSTANT INPUT RANKS 0.5 (§V952), ⊥ 0.** muting a source (`amount = 0`) hands the analysis a CONSTANT ∴ every ranked lane sits MID, & a graph rebuilt on `AudioAnalysis` renders a MID-VALUED picture where the raw-lane version rendered a COLLAPSED one. every gate of the form `muted < loud × k` (E35 `nova-torus.gpu.test.ts` was one: 16.7 % lit loud vs 6.3 % muted, `muted < loud × 0.25`) is therefore ⊥ merely re-tuned but WRONG IN SHAPE after such a rebuild. the replacement measures what the rank actually carries: **the picture MOVES on a varying source & is STILL on a constant one — VARIANCE across a window, ⊥ one frame's level.** that is the stronger reading of §V461 ("the reactivity IS the picture") because a rank cannot fake either arm. RULE: when an example moves to the normaliser, AUDIT ITS CLAIMS FOR MUTE ARMS FIRST & say ∈ the commit which ones changed shape & why — a claim that changed shape is ⊥ a claim that was loosened, but the difference must be ON THE RECORD (§T1266 moved two bounds on a look call; this is the same discipline for a mechanism change)|V952,V461,T1234,T1271
V956|⚑**WHEN AN EXAMPLE STARTS INSTANCING A COMPONENT, THE AUDIT IS EVERY TEST THAT CALLS `compileGraph` ∨ `renderHeadless` ON THAT EXAMPLE'S GRAPH — ⊥ the tests whose NAMES mention it.** a consumer that re-compiles an example WITHOUT being handed its component library fails on the flattening, & NOTHING ABOUT THE EDITED FILE POINTS AT THAT CONSUMER ∴ `vitest related` & every scoped run miss it by construction (the §T1229-class "no dependency-graph selector can find this" problem, here for fixtures rather than gates). MEASURED TWICE: §T1234 threaded FIVE such consumers for E24 & still left `temporal.test.ts` RED (e559a68), found only when §T1271 tripped the IDENTICAL assertion from E35 — the same bug, in the same file, discovered by a different example a day later. RULE: grep the `compileGraph`/`renderHeadless` call sites for the example, ⊥ its name, & thread components through all of them ∈ the same commit|T1234,T1271,V437,T615
V957|⚑⚑**A GATE THAT WALKS THE SOURCE TREE ∨ THE DOCUMENT SET IS UNREACHABLE BY EVERY DEPENDENCY-GRAPH SELECTOR — "I ran the tests for what I touched" IS STRUCTURALLY UNABLE TO FIND IT.** `readdirSync`/glob gates & document-set gates (`layout.test.ts` reads the DOCUMENTS, ⊥ any example's tests) have no import edge from the file you edited ∴ `vitest related`, a scoped path run, & the module graph ALL miss them by construction — ⊥ by accident. `test:gates` exists for exactly this & catches the twelve tree-walkers, but **it is a HAND-MAINTAINED LIST ∈ `package.json` & `layout.test.ts` is ⊥ ON IT** ∴ §V389 sat red on two freshly-landed rows (E35 §T1271 an hour old, E24 §T1234) & every scoped run passed. MEASURED: §V956 is the same failure w/ a different gate — same cause, different victim. RULE: a gate of this class ! be ON the `test:gates` list, & the list ! be DERIVED ∨ ITS OWN GATE — a hand-maintained list of the gates that nothing else can find is one edit away from being wrong (§T1273)|V956,V389,T1272,T1234,T1271
V958|⚑**A CLAIM THAT RENDERS TWO FRAMES OF A DRIVEN DOCUMENT ! FREEZE EVERY DRIVEN SLOT IT IS ⊥ TESTING — & THE FREEZE ! BE DERIVED FROM THE DOCUMENT, ⊥ WRITTEN AS CONSTANTS.** a two-frame comparison ∈ a document w/ ANY independent clock is ⊥ measuring what it says: it is measuring the difference between two states of every lane that moves. THREE OCCURRENCES ∈ ONE FILE (E57), which is where it stops being bad luck: §T1156's "the frames differ" was VACUOUS (the cloud veil drifts on its own clock ∴ any two frames differ); §T1170b added two audio lanes & the walk's FREEZE stopped being a freeze; §T1279 added a beat lane & broke the walk's motion test AND §T1170b's shaft-occlusion test — the file's CENTRAL claim — because every two-frame pair had become a pair of BEAT PHASES. the repair that holds is §T1279's `beatsAtRest()`: a helper that reads the DOCUMENT & returns every driven slot @ rest, so the next clock added breaks nothing & a RETUNE CANNOT LEAVE A STALE CONSTANT ∈ the test file. a hand-written freeze list is correct exactly until someone adds a lane, & nothing tells them|T1279,T1170b,T1156,V903,V914
V959|⚑**WHEN A RED-VERIFY DOES ⊥ GO RED, THE FIRST HYPOTHESIS IS THAT THE EDIT DID ⊥ REACH THE CODE UNDER TEST — ⊥ THAT THE CLAIM IS WEAK.** a green test after a break you BELIEVE you introduced is TWO facts, ⊥ one: either the claim cannot see the break, ∨ THE BREAK IS ⊥ THERE. measured (§T1284): an anchored edit routing `pbr` back to `"phong"` was applied TWICE & the test passed BOTH times — because there are TWO mapping sites (`scene.ts` instances ~1682, grid ~1894) & both edits landed on the wrong one. the claim was fine the whole time. **THE CHEAP SETTLER IS A PROBE THAT ASKS THE ARTEFACT WHAT IT ACTUALLY CONTAINS** — compile the fixture & ask the PLAN which block the pass carries, read the generated WGSL, hash it — rather than more edits @ the source. corollary: prefer to red-verify AS CLOSE TO THE CLAIM AS POSSIBLE (§T1284 ended up perturbing the shader MATH, which is what the claim is about) — a break inserted far upstream has to survive every mapping, branch & memo between there & the assertion, & each one is a place it can silently fail to arrive|T1284,V147,T1229

RULE: when a predicate appears ∈ more than one file, give it A NAME & A HOME, & have each site's docblock name the other — `lit()` & `envLit()` (§T1289). & when you widen a rule, GREP THE PREDICATE'S MEANING, ⊥ its text: five of these were spelled as the NEGATION & a grep for the positive form found one. ⚠**COROLLARY, from the same incident: a change w/ ZERO blast radius has ZERO GATE. the property that makes it safe to land is the property that makes its own bug invisible** — if nothing renders the path, write the thing that renders it (§T1290) ∨ accept that the first user is the test|T1284,T1289,T1290,V288 ⚑**RATIFIED, ⊥ CHANGED (§T1297's survey): the value ops ALREADY broadcast per-channel through ONE shared `mapChannels` helper (`value-graph-nodes.ts:40`) — `valueMath` (arith & range remap), `valueLimit`, `valueSlope`, `valueTrigger`, `valueLag`, `valueFilter`, `valueStep`, `valueNormalize`, `valueSpeed` all map over the bag w/ INDEPENDENT PER-CHANNEL STATE; `valueSwitch` selects whole bags & crossfades the UNION. V962|⚑**A GLOW IS ⊥ A BLURRED COPY OF ITS SOURCE — IT IS A *COARSER FIELD W/ THE SAME STRUCTURE*.** blurring the source is what everyone reaches for & **it fails whenever the source's DETAIL IS FINER THAN THE BLUR RADIUS — which is ALWAYS, for procedural marks.** measured @ §T1283 stage 2, three versions, the first two plausible & wrong the same way ∈ different clothes: **(v1) sampled along the SURFACE NORMAL** (`p + n * 0.06`) — that moves OFF the surface INTO THE AIR, where the field is whatever sits directly underneath ∴ a lit point read lit, a dark point read dark, & the \"spill\" WAS THE CHANNEL'S OWN VALUE AGAIN; **(v2) sampled four offsets ∈ the TANGENT PLANE** — right direction to move, still the wrong thing to sample: the glyph hash is keyed on cells ~0.2 m across ∴ a 0.12 m tap usually lands ∈ THE SAME CELL & returns the same value — **a blur whose RADIUS IS SMALLER THAN ITS SUBJECT IS ⊥ A BLUR**; **(v3, shipped) ⊥ a blur @ all** — a SEPARATE, WIDER field sharing the channel's STRUCTURE but ⊥ its DETAIL: same row test, same coarse mark, a soft window several times the channel's width, stroke hash DROPPED. it answers *\"is there writing NEAR here\"*, which is what a glow IS. ⚑**& IT IS CHEAPER THAN v2 — one hash pair instead of four field evaluations: THE CORRECT VERSION WAS THE FAST ONE**, which is the part worth remembering when the wrong one feels like the cheap shortcut|T1283,V147 ⚑**COMPANION, ONE DIMENSION UP (§T1283 stage 3): A *VOLUME* WANTS A DIFFERENT FIELD FROM A *SURFACE*, ⊥ A CHEAPER ONE.** two failed volumetrics from opposite ends: sampling the SURFACE's hash-gated (nearly BINARY) field w/ 22 sparse samples is A SPECKLE GENERATOR ⊥ a fog; smoothing it by dropping ALL the hashes paints CONTINUOUS BANDS the full width of the hall, because the row window is A FUNCTION OF HEIGHT ALONE & nothing keys it to A PLACE. what works keeps the row-AND-BAY gate & drops only the FINE hashes — **smooth where it ! be smooth, PLACED where the light actually is**

THE RULE: **when a measurement contradicts what the picture plainly shows, SUSPECT THE WINDOW BEFORE THE WORK.** & the repair ∈ both cases was the same shape: **SOLVE the window from the geometry (E69's centres from the eye distance & the fov; E33's mask from muted bloom & a soloed subject) rather than GUESSING it** — a window that is DERIVED cannot straddle an edge by accident, & a window that is EYEBALLED will, eventually, on some frame nobody looked at|T1296,T1290,V147,V640,V959

V967|⚑⚑**DO ⊥ FRAME AN *ART-DIRECTION* CHOICE AS A *COST* CHOICE — & ⊥ W/ NUMBERS NOBODY MEASURED.** §T1310b: the orchestrator put three E70 directions to the owner w/ an ms ESTIMATE attached to each as the headline discriminator. the owner's answer: *"stop tripping about costs. you did that last time and it turned out to be totally unnecessary since we had plenty of budget. i did not tell you to judge all my example requests at your wild and often wrongly estimated performance budget caps."* **THEY ARE RIGHT & IT IS A REPEAT: §V963 EXISTS BECAUSE THE SAME THING HAPPENED ON §T1283 — an unmeasured 25–35 ms estimate chose a direction, set a ceiling, designed an abort & asked the owner to accept a price, & THE PIECE SHIPPED @ 4.76 ms. the orchestrator then did it AGAIN ∈ the NEXT ROW, after the owner had ALREADY said \"go all out\".** ⇒ **V963 was ⊥ enough because it said MEASURE BEFORE QUOTING; the missing half is WHERE A NUMBER BELONGS @ ALL.** THE RULE: **a LOOK question is answered w/ LOOKS — what the thing IS, what it reads as, what it resembles. cost is an ENGINEERING constraint & belongs ∈ the BUILD, ⊥ ∈ the CHOICE — & it belongs there as a MEASUREMENT taken per stage, which is what the staged discipline is FOR.** ⚠**& NOTE THE ESTIMATES WERE WRONG ∈ THE *PESSIMISTIC* DIRECTION BOTH TIMES: the damage is ⊥ overspending, it is TALKING THE OWNER OUT OF AN AFFORDABLE IDEA.** a guess presented beside a real choice is an ARGUMENT, ⊥ information — & the owner has ⊥ asked for a budget cap on ANY example request|V963,T1310b,T1283,T1304b

V969|⚑**A DISTANCE ESTIMATOR IS A *PAIR* — THE MAP & ITS DERIVATIVE — & CHANGING ONE W/O THE OTHER PRODUCES *A PICTURE*, ⊥ AN ERROR.** §T1310b: E70's affine step ran `p = p*scale + juliaC` (a JULIA iteration: adds a CONSTANT) beside `dr = dr*abs(scale) + 1.0` (**the MANDELBOX derivative, which assumes the added term differentiates to 1 w.r.t. the ray's START; a CONSTANT differentiates to 0**) ∴ `dr` ran systematically LARGE & the estimate systematically SMALL — **conservative rather than dangerous, so it did ⊥ crash ∨ artefact, IT JUST CREPT**; & the set itself was ⊥ there (a Mandelbox-Julia @ that scale is A THIN DUST: **86.1 % of the frame near-black, mean luma 7.53, a scatter of specks & no object**). **NEITHER HALF RAISES AN ERROR ANYWHERE: a wrong derivative is a SLOW MARCH & a wrong map is A DIFFERENT SHAPE, & both look like \"the art direction is ⊥ working yet\".** THE RULE: **when either half of a DE changes, CHANGE BOTH & SAY WHICH DERIVATIVE FORM THE MAP EARNS** — & prefer a form whose derivative is EXACT (the true Mandelbox's `+1` is exact for the ray's own start plus a drifting offset, which is why E70 ships that rather than the Julia constant it was designed around, & the topology-evolution axis survives)|T1310b,V147,V968

## §P PARALLEL PLAN

wave = barrier. tracks ∈ wave run concurrent. track owns disjoint paths → ⊥ write collision.
rule: track ⊥ edit file outside owned paths. shared contract frozen @ wave 0.
cross-track need → raise, ⊥ patch other track path.
**⊥ transient probe files ∈ `src/`. an audit that writes `zz-probe.ts` & self-cleans still breaks `pnpm typecheck` for EVERY other session ∈ the window it exists. probe ∈ the scratchpad — it audits identically & is invisible to the shared tree.

**THE INDEX IS SHARED. `git add <path> && git commit` is ⊥ SAFE.**
`git add` ADDS to an index other sessions are also staging into; `git commit` then commits
the WHOLE index. staging explicitly protects nothing — the sweep happens on the COMMITTER's
side & takes whatever anyone else left staged.
**`git rm` STAGES.** a staged deletion sits ∈ the shared index & rides the next bare commit
from ANY session. for deletions: plain `rm`, then name the path ∈ `git commit -- <paths>`.
that is the door the path rule ⊥ cover.

**`git diff HEAD` before committing catches a STALE EDITOR BUFFER too.** an Edit wrote back a
buffer that predated another session's committed line & silently reverted it; the diff caught it
& the line was restored. the tool-level hazard is the same shape as the index one: what you are
committing is ⊥ only what you typed.

**READ THE INDEX BEFORE COMMITTING: `git diff --cached --stat`.** ⊥ after — printing it ∈ the
same command as the commit shows you the contamination ∈ the output of the thing that already
happened. that is how HEAD got a dangling export: another track's STAGED DELETIONS rode a commit
whose author had named 4 explicit paths of their own.

**PATH SCOPING IS FILE-LEVEL.** `commit -- <paths>` protects against the INDEX; it ⊥ split
co-resident HUNKS inside a file 2 tracks are both editing. the 4th "sweep" was ⊥ a rule breach
— the committer used the correct form & the file was legitimately theirs to commit while ALSO
carrying another track's uncommitted hunks. I diagnosed it as a breach & was wrong.
∴ before committing a SHARED file: `git diff HEAD -- <file>`, eyeball for foreign hunks, &
either coordinate the land order | accept & NOTE the rider ∈ the message.
NUANCE: `-- <paths>` ⊥ reference UNTRACKED files (`pathspec did not match`). for NEW files:
`git add <the new files ONLY>` then `git commit -- <all paths>` — the scoping still holds.
! `git commit -- <paths>` (| `git commit <paths>`): commits ONLY those paths, whatever else
sits ∈ the index.
3 incidents ∈ 1 session. the 3rd was MINE, & my own rule was the insufficient one: I wrote
"explicit paths ∈ `git add`" & then swept 968 lines of a track's staged work into a SPEC
commit while following it. a rule that names the wrong command trains people to feel safe.
⊥ `git add -A` | `git add .` | `git commit -a` while tracks live.** explicit paths ONLY. a track swept 7 files of another session's uncommitted work into its commit; repaired w/ `git restore --staged` (index only, ⊥ worktree) & disclosed. `-A` is ⊥ a convenience here, it is a cross-session data hazard — the sweeping track cannot know what it took. HAPPENED TWICE: the 2nd time a `commit -a` swept another track's STAGED diff into an unrelated spec commit. stage explicit paths, ∀ time.

**GATES THAT LIE — ! know which command actually checks:**
- bare `tsc --noEmit` @ root checks NOTHING & exits 0 (references-only tsconfig, `files: []`). ! `pnpm typecheck`.
- `vitest` ⊥ typecheck. a suite is green while the types are red.
- a unit test on shader SOURCE (`toContain("frameU.time")`) is ⊥ evidence a pixel moved (V147, B15).
∀ 3 have already produced a false green this project. a gate you ⊥ verified is a gate you ⊥ have.

⊥ `git stash` | `git checkout` | any tree-wide git op while tracks live — stash cycles OTHER tracks' uncommitted work. blame a file w/ `git diff HEAD -- <path>`, ⊥ tree-wide state changes.
